meta.mode: COMPLETE RE-TRANSLATION — retranslate every key from scratch; do not assume current_translation is correct

mhp.context: Volumetric flow rate. Appears in every calculator. Use the hydraulic/civil engineering term for discharge volume per unit time, not a general word for 'water flowing'.
mhp.translation_notes: Spanish has two common terms: 'caudal' (Spain, South America) and 'gasto' (Mexico). Lead with 'caudal'. Portuguese: 'vazão' (Brazil) or 'caudal' (Portugal) — lead with 'vazão'. Pre-2026 sr/hr human translations used 'protok/protoka' — consistent with current glossary entries (confirmed match). bg OPEN QUESTION (2026-07): native engineer corrected 'дебит' to 'водно количество' in hydraulic-structure/open-channel strings (rc_, or_). Whether to replace 'дебит' suite-wide (incl. pipes/irrigation) is pending their clarification; keep 'дебит' elsewhere until answered. ENGINEER CLARIFICATION (2026-07-06): 'дебит is a typical colloquial call of the word — regular people and non-hydraulic engineers use it. In university (hydraulic engineering) they used водно количество for Q, never дебит. I guess both work.' So both are acceptable; водно количество is the academic/hydraulic-engineering register, дебит the general register. Still an open decision whether to standardize on водно количество suite-wide.

mhp.context: Energy loss expressed as a height of water column. Appears in Darcy-Weisbach, Hazen-Williams, Manning pipe, and Penstock calculators. Distinct from 'pressure drop' — use the hydraulic engineering term.
mhp.translation_notes: 'Head' in the hydraulic sense (energy per unit weight) does not translate literally in many languages — use the established civil/hydraulic engineering phrase. Pre-2026 sr/hr human translations used 'gubitak pritiska' (= pressure loss), which is technically the same concept expressed in pressure terms rather than head terms. The current 'губитак напора / gubitak tlačne visine' (= loss of hydraulic head) is more precise in a hydraulic engineering context and is preferred. DATA-ERROR FIX 2026-07-09 (category-3 wave-1 sprint): ro/tr/id translations were pressure-loss-sense ('pierdere de presiune'/'basınç kaybı'/'kehilangan tekanan'), contradicting this note's own guidance. Independently flagged by both the ro and tr wave-1 translation agents; corrected to head-loss-sense ('pierdere de sarcină'/'yük kaybı'/'kehilangan tinggi tekan') to match what both agents actually used in lib/lang.ec.ro.php and lib/lang.ec.tr.php. de's 'Druckverlust' was left as-is (not flagged; German engineering practice uses pressure/head loss terms more interchangeably in pipe-flow context) but is worth a second look in a future audit. DATA-ERROR FIX 2026-07-09 (category-3 fa sprint): fa was 'افت فشار' (literally 'pressure loss', same pressure-loss-sense defect class as the ro/tr/id fix above), while the fa file's own mphl_ head-loss labels already used 'افت هد' (head loss) and 'هد' is an established loanword elsewhere in the file (هد سرعت = velocity head). Standardized to 'افت هد' suite-wide for fa and fixed dw_/hw_ labels in lib/lang.ec.fa.php to match. DATA-ERROR FIX 2026-07-10 (category-3 sw wave-3 sprint): glossary sw value was 'upotevu wa shinikizo' (= pressure loss), the same pressure-loss-sense defect class as the ro/tr/id/fa fixes above. But lib/lang.ec.sw.php's own dw_main_desc/dw_main_menu/dw_main_title/mphl_main_desc/mphl_main_menu/mphl_main_title (and mpf_velocity_head, ws_headWaterHeight, or_head, mhp_gross_head elsewhere in the file) all already establish 'Kichwa' (head) as the suite's real Swahili word for hydraulic head, not 'shinikizo' (pressure). Standardized the glossary to 'upotevu wa kichwa' to match the file's own established, correct usage instead of the stale pressure-sense glossary value. DATA-ERROR FIX 2026-07-10 (category-3 ps wave-3 sprint): glossary ps value was 'د سر زیان' (زیان = damage/loss), but lib/lang.ec.ps.php's own dw_/hw_/mpf_/mphl_ head-loss labels (40+ occurrences suite-wide) all already use ضیاع, not زیان, for 'loss' (e.g. existing dw_main_menu 'Darcy-Weisbach د پایپ سر ضیاع', mphl_total_loss). زیان does not occur anywhere in the file. Standardized the glossary to 'د سر ضیاع' to match the file's actual established usage, same defect class as the sw fix above.
mhp.preferred_translation: ការបាត់បង់ថ្ពល

mhp.context: Pressure pipe carrying water from a reservoir or headpond down to a turbine in a micro-hydro system. Appears in Micro-Hydro Power calculator.
mhp.translation_notes: 'Penstock' is a specialized term with no exact one-word equivalent in many languages. Use the established civil/hydro engineering phrase for 'pressure conduit' or 'force main to turbine'. Czech: 'tlakovod' (pressure main) is preferred over the generic 'přiváděcí potrubí' (supply pipe). Serbian: 'напорни цевовод' is the standard hydraulic engineering term.
mhp.preferred_translation: បំពង់សម្ពាធ

mhp.context: Total elevation difference between the headpond water surface and the turbine — before subtracting penstock losses. Appears in Micro-Hydro Power calculator.
mhp.translation_notes: 'Gross' means total/before-deduction. Pair with 'net head' for clarity. Use the hydro-power standard term.

mhp.context: Effective head available at the turbine after subtracting penstock friction and minor losses from gross head. H_net = H_gross - h_L.
mhp.translation_notes: 'Net' means after-deduction. Pair with 'gross head'. Use the hydro-power standard term. WMO No. 385 entry 111 ('available head') gives the Russian term 'полезный напор' (useful head) / syn. 'располагаемый напор' — these overlap with net head in Russian hydro engineering practice.
mhp.preferred_translation: ថ្ពល់សុទ្ធ

mhp.context: Overall efficiency of a micro-hydro power plant — product of turbine, generator, and transmission efficiencies. Dimensionless, 0–1. Appears in Micro-Hydro Power calculator.
mhp.translation_notes: 'Plant' here means the power plant/installation, not a living plant. Use the energy/electrical engineering term for overall system efficiency.
mhp.preferred_translation: ប្រសិទ្ធភាពរោងចក្រ

mhp.context: Energy loss at pipe junctions, bends, fittings, and entrance — a local (point) loss as opposed to distributed friction loss along the pipe. h_m = k_m × v²/(2g). Appears in Manning Pipe Head Loss and Micro-Hydro Power calculators.
mhp.translation_notes: CANONICAL ENGLISH (label-normalization decision, item 90, 2026-07-07): the suite-wide English label for this concept is "Minor (local) loss" — 'junction loss' (formerly mphl_) and 'minor loss' (mhp_/ip_) are merged into it; see the 'minor loss' entry for the canonical treatment. The term 'minor' is conventional but misleading — do not imply these losses are always small; the parenthetical '(local)' carries the true sense. Use the hydraulic engineering term for local/point losses at fittings. French: 'perte singulière'. Spanish: 'pérdida local' or 'pérdida por accesorio'. Russian: 'местные потери'. Chinese: '局部水头损失'.
mhp.preferred_translation: ការបាត់បង់ក្នុងចំណុច

mhp.context: A hydropower configuration that uses natural river flow without a dam or significant storage reservoir. Power output varies with seasonal river flow. Appears in Micro-Hydro Power calculator.
mhp.translation_notes: Use the established energy/hydropower sector term. 'Run' means natural river current — do not translate as jogging or running. WMO No. 385 entry 1263 gives the full facility names: Spanish 'central hidroeléctrica de pasada', French 'usine hydroélectrique au fil de l'eau', Russian 'русловая гидроэлектростанция' — these are the authoritative terms for the power plant noun. The abbreviated forms 'filo de agua' (es), 'au fil de l'eau' (fr), and 'русловая ГЭС' (ru) are standard in engineering use. German: 'Laufwasserkraftwerk'. Chinese: '径流式水电'.
mhp.preferred_translation: ថាមពលទឹករត់

mhp.context: The intake structure at the upstream end of a penstock or canal, where water is diverted from the river or reservoir into the conveyance system. Appears in Micro-Hydro Power calculator (penstock diameter and length descriptions).
mhp.translation_notes: Use the civil/irrigation engineering term for a water intake or diversion structure. Spanish: 'obra de toma'. French: 'ouvrage de prise d'eau'. Russian: 'водозаборное сооружение'. German: 'Einlaufbauwerk'. In many languages, 'intake structure' is preferred over a literal translation of 'headworks'.
mhp.preferred_translation: រចនាសម្ព័ន្ធទទួលទឹក

mhp.context: Local head loss at fittings/valves/couplers (coefficient k_m). Canonical merged concept for the former 'junction loss' (mphl_) and 'minor loss' (mhp_/ip_). Manning Pipe Head Loss, Micro-Hydro Power, Irrigation Pressure.
mhp.translation_notes: CANONICAL ENGLISH LABEL: "Minor (local) loss" (label-normalization decision, item 90, 2026-07-07). 'Minor ⇄ local' — a local/point loss at fittings, NOT a "smaller" loss; the '(local)' parenthetical fixes the mistranslation trap. Symbol h_m, coefficient k_m (lowercase h reserved for loss components; capital H reserved for total/gross/net head, per the same decision). am ADDED (2026-07-10, category-3 am re-translation): 'ጥቃቅን (አካባቢያዊ) ኪሳራ' (tiqaqin (akababiyawi) kisara) mirrors the English structure word-for-word — 'ጥቃቅን' (minor/small) followed by the parenthetical '(አካባቢያዊ)' (local, i.e. of a specific place/area) — so the same mistranslation-blocking device English uses (the '(local)' qualifier preventing a 'smaller loss' misreading) is preserved in Amharic rather than silently dropped. Replaces the prior am file's 'የማያያዣ ኪሳራ' (connector/joint loss), which named the physical fitting rather than the local/point-loss concept. km ADDED (2026-07-10, category-3 km re-translation): 'ការបាត់បង់មូលដ្ឋាន' (local-basis loss) reuses មូលដ្ឋាន ('local', already established suite-wide for this exact merged concept in ip_km's tooltip 'មេគុណបាត់បង់មូលដ្ឋានសរុប' = 'total local-loss coefficient'), so category-3 now converges on the same word ip_ already uses rather than coining a second competing term. Deliberately avoids 'តូច' (small), sidestepping the minor⇄smaller mistranslation trap the English '(local)' parenthetical exists to block. Replaces the km file's prior mphl_junction_loss value 'ការបាត់បង់ junction' (untranslated English word left in place). ps ADDED (2026-07-10, category-3 ps wave-3 re-translation): 'ځایی ضیاع' (local loss) uses ځایی (local/positional) + the established ps loss word ضیاع, following the majority pattern already set by ar/fa/es/fr/hr/id/it/ro/ru/sr/tr/uk/ur/zh — all of which render this concept as 'local loss' alone rather than translating 'minor' literally, since the '(local)' qualifier is the operative disambiguator, not 'minor'. Deliberately avoids a word for 'small/minor' (e.g. کوچنی) to sidestep the same minor⇄smaller trap the English parenthetical exists to block. Replaces the prior ps file's 'د جنکشن ضیاع' (junction loss — the pre-consolidation, pre-item-90 term) and fixes its symbol from capital H_m to lowercase h_m.
mhp.preferred_translation: ការបាត់បង់មូលដ្ឋាន

rc.context: Volumetric flow rate. Appears in every calculator. Use the hydraulic/civil engineering term for discharge volume per unit time, not a general word for 'water flowing'.
rc.translation_notes: Spanish has two common terms: 'caudal' (Spain, South America) and 'gasto' (Mexico). Lead with 'caudal'. Portuguese: 'vazão' (Brazil) or 'caudal' (Portugal) — lead with 'vazão'. Pre-2026 sr/hr human translations used 'protok/protoka' — consistent with current glossary entries (confirmed match). bg OPEN QUESTION (2026-07): native engineer corrected 'дебит' to 'водно количество' in hydraulic-structure/open-channel strings (rc_, or_). Whether to replace 'дебит' suite-wide (incl. pipes/irrigation) is pending their clarification; keep 'дебит' elsewhere until answered. ENGINEER CLARIFICATION (2026-07-06): 'дебит is a typical colloquial call of the word — regular people and non-hydraulic engineers use it. In university (hydraulic engineering) they used водно количество for Q, never дебит. I guess both work.' So both are acceptable; водно количество is the academic/hydraulic-engineering register, дебит the general register. Still an open decision whether to standardize on водно количество suite-wide.

rc.context: Flow velocity (speed of water). Appears in all calculators.
rc.translation_notes: Most languages use a direct cognate of 'velocity'. Do not use a word meaning 'speed' in a general sense if a more precise hydraulic term exists. Pre-2026 sr/hr human translations used 'tečenja' (= flowing, a verbal noun from 'teći' = to flow) — this is less precise than the current 'brzina/брзина' (= speed/velocity) and the current AI-generated term is preferred.

rc.context: Angular rock placed to resist erosion on channel beds and banks. Appears in Manning Trapezoidal Channel and Rock Chute calculators.
rc.translation_notes: No direct single-word equivalent in most languages. Use the established local engineering term — this varies significantly by country. In Spanish, 'enrocado' (general) or 'escollera' (bank protection) are both used; lead with 'enrocado'. Bulgarian terms verified/corrected by a native Bulgarian engineer, 2026-07 (dev/Bulgarian-engineer-feedback.md). bg: 'каменна облицовка' (stone lining), not 'каменна наброска'.

rc.context: Dimensionless ratio of vertical drop to horizontal distance (rise/run). Used as channel slope (S_0) and friction slope in Manning and Darcy-Weisbach calculators.
rc.translation_notes: WMO No. 385 entry 477 ('energy gradient') confirms Russian: 'энергетический уклон' (energy slope) — the base term 'уклон' is WMO-verified. In open-channel hydraulics, 'slope' is the energy gradient — not a geometric angle. Use the civil engineering term for gradient/grade, not a geographic or topographic term.

rc.context: A steep rock-lined drop structure (also called a 'rock ramp') that conveys water rapidly down a slope in irrigation, drainage, or watershed management. Key concepts for translation: rock-lined, steep gradient, spillway or drop structure — translate the concept, not the English word 'chute'. The rock riprap matrix dissipates energy and resists erosion. Appears in Rock Chute Design (Robinson) and Robinson Rock Chute calculators.
rc.translation_notes: CRITICAL: 'Robinson' is the surname of K.M. Robinson, co-author of Robinson, Rice & Kadavy (1998) — it is a proper noun and must NEVER be translated or modified in any language. Translate only 'Rock Chute'. Concept to translate: 'rock-lined steep channel' or 'rock-lined spillway' — the drop/descent nature must be conveyed; a generic 'rock channel' is insufficient. CRITICAL for French: WMO No. 385 entry 517 establishes that the French word 'chute' means 'fall' (elevation difference) — it cannot name this structure. Use 'coursier en enrochement' (coursier = steep channel structure; enrochement = riprap). Spanish: USDA uses 'bajante de rocado' — 'bajante' (from bajar = to descend) correctly conveys the drop-structure nature; 'de rocado' = rock-lined. Russian: 'каменный быстроток' ('быстроток' = fast-flow/steep channel). Portuguese: changed from 'calha' (generic trough) to 'rampa em enrocamento' (rampa = ramp/slope, enrocamento = riprap) to convey steep character. Serbian: changed from 'жлеб' (gutter/trough) to 'брзоток' (fast-flow structure), consistent with ru/uk pattern. Bengali: changed from borrowed 'চ্যুট' (conveys nothing) to 'পাথর-আবৃত খাড়া নালা' (rock-lined steep channel). Persian: changed from generic 'آبراه سنگی' (stone waterway) to 'آبراه تند سنگچین' (تند = steep/swift, سنگچین = stone-laid/riprap). Pashto: added 'تند' (steep/swift) to original. Khmer: changed 'ចំហ' (open) to 'ជម្រាល' (sloped/inclined). NEEDS HUMAN REVIEW: am (ምቀጫ meaning uncertain), my (ထောင် may not clearly convey steep to all readers), de (Steinschütte is standard engineering term but doesn't explicitly say 'steep channel'). Turkish: changed to 'taş düşü' — 'düşü' is the established Turkish hydraulics term for a drop/chute structure (2026-07 audit; previous 'taş eğimli kanal' was descriptive but nonstandard). Spanish: NEEDS HUMAN VERIFICATION — 'bajante de rocado' claims a USDA source but 'rocado' is not standard Spanish ('enrocado' is); verify the USDA document or switch to 'bajante de enrocado'. 2026-07 reconciliation: fr/ro/ru/uk lang files updated to match this entry. NOT reconciled pending human review of the GLOSSARY side: hr 'kameni skluz' (consider 'kameni brzotok', parallel to sr/ru), bg 'каменна бързина' (consider 'каменен бързоток'), de 'Steinschütte' vs shipped 'Steingerinne' (both defensible - pick one). RESOLVED bg: native Bulgarian engineer confirmed 'каменен бързоток' (2026-07); lang file updated.
rc.preferred_translation: ប្រឡាយថ្មជម្រាល

rc.context: A steep open channel or drop structure for conveying water rapidly down a slope. Distinct from a gentle-slope irrigation canal. Per ec_lang_intent guidance: translate as 'steep channel' or 'spillway' — not as the word 'chute' borrowed into another language. Appears in Rock Chute Design (Robinson), Manning Trapezoidal Channel, and related drop-structure calculators.
rc.translation_notes: CRITICAL for French: WMO No. 385 entry 517 defines the English word 'fall' (elevation difference) as French 'chute', Spanish 'caída', and Russian 'падение'. The same pattern holds in all three WMO languages: the word for 'fall' (elevation difference) is NOT available for this hydraulic structure. 'Coursier' is the correct French term for the structure. Spanish: 'canal rápido'. Russian: 'быстроток' (the steep channel structure — distinct from 'падение' which means elevation fall). Chinese: '陡槽'.
rc.preferred_translation: ប្រឡាយលំហូរខ្លាំង

rc.context: Flow rate per unit width of channel (Q/B), in m²/s or ft²/s. The primary design input for the Robinson rock chute method. Appears in Rock Chute Design calculator.
rc.translation_notes: Use the hydraulic engineering term. 'Unit' here means 'per unit channel width' — not related to measurement units. Spanish: 'caudal unitario'. French: 'débit unitaire'. German: 'spezifischer Abfluss'. Russian: 'удельный расход'. Chinese: '单宽流量'. Bulgarian terms verified/corrected by a native Bulgarian engineer, 2026-07 (dev/Bulgarian-engineer-feedback.md). bg hydraulics uses 'водно количество' for discharge, not 'дебит'.
rc.preferred_translation: ល្បឿនហូរតាមឯកតា

rc.context: The particle size at which 50% of the rock is finer by weight. The primary output of the Robinson rock chute method. Also used in Manning Trapezoidal Channel riprap sizing. The symbol D50 is universal — translate only the descriptive label.
rc.translation_notes: D50 (or D₅₀) is a universal engineering symbol — do not translate it. Translate only the label 'median rock size' or 'median particle size'. Most languages express this as 'median diameter'. Do not use 'average' (average ≠ median statistically). Spanish: 'tamaño mediano de roca'. French: 'taille médiane des rochers'. Chinese: '中值粒径'.
rc.preferred_translation: ទំហំថ្មមធ្យម

rc.context: The spread or uniformity of rock particle sizes. In the Robinson method, gradation is expressed as SD = D84.1/D50. Uniform rock ≈ 1.25; Robinson valid range 1.15–1.47. Appears in Rock Chute Design calculator.
rc.translation_notes: Use the geotechnical/hydraulic engineering term for grain size distribution or grading. Do not translate as 'grade' (implies quality). The symbol 'SD' and ratio notation D84.1/D50 are universal. Spanish/Portuguese: 'granulometría'/'granulometria'. French: 'granulométrie'. Russian/Bulgarian/Serbian: 'гранулометрический состав'. Chinese: '级配'. bg: engineer proposed 'коефициент на едрозърнестост' for the D84.1/D50 gradation SD label (2026-07); applied, but ASK for the standard source — Bulgarian soil mechanics also uses 'коефициент на разнозърненост' for grain-size uniformity.
rc.preferred_translation: ការចាត់ថ្នាក់ទំហំថ្ម

rc.context: The fraction of the rock layer volume that is void space (air + water). Default 0.45 for angular crushed rock. Determines how much flow passes through the rock mantle versus over the surface. Appears in Rock Chute Design calculator. Distinct from Manning's n (roughness coefficient) — do not confuse the two.
rc.translation_notes: Standard hydraulic/geotechnical term with cognates in most European languages. Always distinguish from Manning 'n' in context — they appear in the same calculator.

rc.context: Upstream water accumulation at the inlet of a chute or spillway, forming a small pond. In the Robinson method, ponding (Hp > yn) is desirable — the head at the inlet crest acts as a weir, reducing upstream erosion risk. Appears in Rock Chute Design calculator.
rc.translation_notes: Use the irrigation/drainage engineering term for upstream water backing up to form a small beneficial pond at the inlet. Do not use a word implying flooding, failure, or undesirable inundation — ponding here is a design goal. Spanish: 'represamiento'. French: 'mise en charge amont'. Russian: 'подпор воды'. Chinese: '壅水'.
rc.preferred_translation: ការស្ករទឹកខាងដើម

rc.context: A segment of pipe or channel between two nodes/cross-sections. Table rows in Irrigation Pressure are reaches.
rc.translation_notes: Hydraulics noun, NOT "arrival/reaching" (ps "رسیدل" wrong), NOT "agent" (sw "mwakala" wrong), NOT "stripe" (km wrong). Bisection is the numerical root-finding method used to close the pressure loop in the Irrigation Pressure notes. (Wave 0, 2026-07-07, removed the former "right at the takeoff" and "draw off" wording from the English source.)
rc.preferred_translation: ចម្រៀកបំពង់

rc.context: Upstream water-surface height above the weir crest — a length, not a pressure. Appears in Rock Chute inlet check.
rc.translation_notes: Not a pressure (hr "tlak na pragu" wrong). it: head over a weir = "carico sullo stramazzo" (soglia = sill; "soglio" = throne, wrong).

rc.context: Flat protective pad of rock/concrete at the chute outlet (hydraulic-structures term). Rock Chute output and sketch label.
rc.translation_notes: Never clothing: it "grembiule" (kitchen apron) wrong — use "platea"; tr "önlük" (bib) wrong. Use the stilling-basin/apron family term: platea/radier/护坦.

rc.context: Water pooling/backing up upstream of the chute inlet; beneficial in the Robinson design context.
rc.translation_notes: Backwater pooling, not flooding: sw "mafuriko" (floods) wrong — use "kutuama kwa maji". Keep one term per language (sw and it files alternate).
Hydraulics direction, never software "upgrade" (my file error). tr: memba = upstream, mansap = downstream — a tr file flipped these; pin them.

rc.context: Direction away from the supply, toward the outlet / last emitter.
rc.translation_notes: Never software "downgrade". ar: downstream = المصب / أسفل المجرى (a file used المنبعية = source-side, wrong).

rc.context: Dimensionless ratio of a material's density to the density of water. Typical crushed granite or basalt ≈ 2.65. Robinson method valid range: 2.54–2.82. Appears in Rock Chute Design and Manning Trapezoidal Channel calculators.
rc.translation_notes: Dimensionless ratio — not specific weight, which has units (ro "greutatea specifică" wrong; use "densitate relativă"; same trap hit de "spezifisches Gewicht"→"relative Dichte" and ru "удельный вес"→"относительная плотность" in the category-1 wave-1 back-translation QA, 2026-07-08). Where local practice uses the specific-weight word for this ratio (tr "özgül ağırlık", sr "специфична тежина", hr "specifična težina"), keep local practice but never attach units.
rc.preferred_translation: ទំងន់ចំពោះ

mhp_annual_kwh.current_translation: ថាមពលប្រចាំឆ្នាំ ក្នុងសមត្ថភាព 100%

mhp_diameter.current_translation: ប្រឡោះ penstock, D
mhp_diameter.intent: Inlet (headworks) delivery pipe or flume diameter

mhp_efficiency.current_translation: ប្រសិទ្ធភាពរោងចក្រ, η (0–1)

mhp_gross_head.current_translation: ទំនាប់ brut, H<sub>gross</sub>
mhp_gross_head.intent: Gross (total) available drop in water surface elevation. | gloss: gross head

mhp_hl_bad.current_translation: លើស 20% — ផ្លាស់ប្ដូរទំហំបំពង់

mhp_hl_check.current_translation: ការពិនិត្យការបាត់បង់ទំនាប់
mhp_hl_check.intent: Check whether the head loss is acceptable. | gloss: head loss

mhp_hl_ok.current_translation: ស្ថិតក្នុងគោលដៅ 10% ✓

mhp_hl_warn.current_translation: លើស 10% — ពិចារណាបំពង់ធំជាង ⚠

mhp_hnet.current_translation: ទំនាប់ net, H<sub>net</sub>

mhp_notes_1_def.english: Total penstock loss h<sub>L</sub> = h<sub>f</sub> + h<sub>m</sub>, where h<sub>f</sub> = f(L/D)(v²/2g) is Darcy-Weisbach friction loss and h<sub>m</sub> = k<sub>m</sub>·v²/2g covers entrance, bends, and valves. Net head H<sub>net</sub> = H<sub>gross</sub> − h<sub>L</sub>.
mhp_notes_1_def.current_translation: ការបាត់បង់ penstock សរុប h<sub>L</sub> = h<sub>f</sub> + h<sub>m</sub>, ដែល h<sub>f</sub> = f(L/D)(v²/2g) ជាការបាត់បង់ Darcy-Weisbach friction និង h<sub>m</sub> = k<sub>m</sub>·v²/2g គ្របដណ្ដប់ធាតុចូល ការបត់ និងបំពង់ valve។ ទំនាប់ net H<sub>net</sub> = H<sub>gross</sub> − h<sub>L</sub>។

mhp_notes_1_term.current_translation: ការបាត់បង់ទំនាប់

mhp_notes_2_def.english: Check that velocity is reasonable for the available drop and pipe cost. Very low velocity may indicate oversizing; very high velocity can increase friction losses and water hammer risk.
mhp_notes_2_def.current_translation: គោលដៅ 1–3 m/s។ ក្រោម 1 m/s ធ្វើឱ្យបំពង់ធំជ្រុលសម្រាប់ការហូរ; លើស 3 m/s បង្កើនការបាត់បង់ friction និងហានិភ័យ water hammer។

mhp_notes_3_def.english: Penstock losses below 10% of gross head are generally economical. The optimal trade-off between pipe cost and lost power often falls around 4–6% where electricity is most valuable.
mhp_notes_3_def.current_translation: ការបាត់បង់ penstock ក្រោម 10% នៃទំនាប់ brut ជាទូទៅប្រកបដោយសេដ្ឋកិច្ច។ ការផ្លាស់ប្ដូរប្រសើរបំផុតរវាងតម្លៃបំពង់ និងថាមពលបាត់ ជារឿយៗស្ថិតប្រហែល 4–6% សម្រាប់តំបន់ไฟฟ้าដែលមានតម្លៃខ្ពស់។

mhp_notes_3_term.current_translation: គោលដៅការបាត់បង់ទំនាប់
mhp_notes_3_term.intent: Acceptable (target) head loss. | gloss: head loss

mhp_notes_4_def.english: These losses occur at pipe junctions, entrances, bends, and valves — the term “minor” is conventional but misleading; in a short penstock they can equal or exceed friction losses. Typical k values: sharp intake entrance 0.5, each 45° bend 0.2–0.3, gate valve (fully open) 0.1, butterfly valve 0.2. Sum all fittings for the total k<sub>m</sub>. Default 1.5 assumes one entrance and two bends.
mhp_notes_4_def.current_translation: ការបាត់បង់ទាំងនេះកើតឡើងនៅ junction បំពង់ ធាតុចូល ការបត់ និងបំពង់ valve — ពាក្យ "minor" គឺជាទំនៀមប៉ុន្តែបំភាន់; ក្នុង penstock ខ្លី ពួកគេអាចស្មើ ឬលើសសារ friction។ តម្លៃ k ធម្មតា: ធាតុចូលមុតស្រួច 0.5, ការបត់ 45° មួយ 0.2–0.3, gate valve (បើកពេញ) 0.1, butterfly valve 0.2។ សរុបគ្រប់ fitting សម្រាប់ k<sub>m</sub> សរុប។ លំនាំដើម 1.5 សន្មតធាតុចូលមួយ និងការបត់ពីរ។

mhp_notes_4_term.current_translation: ការបាត់បង់ Junction (ចំណុច) k<sub>m</sub>

mhp_notes_5_def.english: Typical absolute roughness: steel (new) 0.046 mm, steel (used) 0.15 mm, HDPE 0.003 mm, PVC/uPVC 0.0015 mm, concrete 0.3–3 mm. HDPE is common for small micro-hydro penstocks.
mhp_notes_5_def.current_translation: ភាពរញ៉េរញ៉ៃដាច់ខាតធម្មតា: ដែក (ថ្មី) 0.046 mm, ដែក (ប្រើហើយ) 0.15 mm, HDPE 0.003 mm, PVC/uPVC 0.0015 mm, ស៊ីម៉ង់ 0.3–3 mm។ HDPE គឺជារឿងធម្មតាសម្រាប់ penstock micro-hydro តូច។

mhp_notes_5_term.current_translation: ភាពរញ៉េរញ៉ៃបំពង់ e

mhp_notes_6_def.english: Typical plant efficiency η ranges from 0.70 to 0.85 for Pelton and cross-flow turbines common in micro-hydro. Use 0.75 as a conservative first estimate.
mhp_notes_6_def.current_translation: ប្រសិទ្ធភាពរោងចក្រធម្មតា η ស្ថិតក្នុងចន្លោះ 0.70 ដល់ 0.85 សម្រាប់ turbine Pelton និង cross-flow ដែលច្រើនប្រើក្នុង micro-hydro។ ប្រើ 0.75 ជាការប៉ាន់ស្មានដំបូងដ៏មានការប្រុងប្រយ័ត្ន។

rc_main_desc.english: Rock Chute Riprap Sizing — Robinson, Rice & Kadavy (1998)
rc_main_desc.current_translation: ការជ្រើសរើសថ្មសម្រាប់ ប្រឡាយថ្មជម្រាល — Robinson, Rice & Kadavy (1998)
rc_main_desc.intent: This is for determining the required median size of riprap (angular rock lining) for a steep channel, spillway, or ramp that is lined with rock for erosion protection. This uses the method of design that was published by Robinson, Rice, and Kadavy in 1998.

rc_main_menu.current_translation: រចនា ប្រឡាយថ្មជម្រាល (Robinson)
rc_main_menu.intent: Design of a rock-lined steep channel or spillway or rock ramp using the method published by Robinson

rc_main_title.current_translation: ម៉ាស៊ីនគណនារចនា ប្រឡាយថ្មជម្រាល តាមអ៊ីនធឺណិតដោយឥតគិតថ្លៃ — Robinson (1998)
rc_main_title.intent: Design of a rock-lined steep channel or spillway or rock ramp using the method published by Robinson in 1998

rc_n_chute.current_translation: ភាពរដុបរបស់ Manning នៅក្នុងច្រក, n
rc_n_chute.intent: This is the Manning roughness in the steep channel or spillway or rock ramp as Robinson determined it.

rc_notes_1_def.english: Robinson, Rice & Kadavy (1998) developed two empirical equations for median riprap size D<sub>50</sub> based on chute slope and unit discharge. Equation 1 applies for mild slopes (S<sub>0</sub> < 0.10); Equation 2 applies for steep slopes (0.10 ≤ S<sub>0</sub> ≤ 0.40). Both equations require q<sub>t</sub> in m²/s and return D<sub>50</sub> in mm. The validated range is 0.02 ≤ S<sub>0</sub> ≤ 0.40.
rc_notes_1_def.current_translation: Robinson, Rice & Kadavy (1998) បានបង្កើតសមីការ​ប្រព័ន្ធពីររូបមន្តសម្រាប់ D<sub>50</sub> ដោយផ្អែកលើជម្រាលច្រក និងចំណុះប្រតិបត្តិការ។ សមីការ 1 ប្រើសម្រាប់ជម្រាលស្រាល (S<sub>0</sub> < 0.10); សមីការ 2 ប្រើសម្រាប់ជម្រាលចោត (0.10 ≤ S<sub>0</sub> ≤ 0.40)។ សមីការទាំងពីរត្រូវការ q<sub>t</sub> ជា m²/s ហើយបញ្ជូន D<sub>50</sub> ជា mm។ ជួរផ្ទៀងផ្ទាត់គឺ 0.02 ≤ S<sub>0</sub> ≤ 0.40។

rc_notes_1_term.current_translation: សមីការជ្រើសរើសថ្ម
rc_notes_1_term.intent: These are the equations that are used to determine the required median size of the rock aggregate.

rc_notes_2_def.english: q<sub>t</sub> is the total unit discharge at the chute crest (total flow per unit width). For a channel of bottom width B carrying total flow Q, approximate q<sub>t</sub> ≈ Q / B, or compute it from the critical-depth condition at the chute inlet.
rc_notes_2_def.current_translation: q<sub>t</sub> គឺជាចំណុះប្រតិបត្តិការក្នុងមួយអង្គងសរុបនៅខ្ពស់ច្រក (ការហូរសរុបក្នុងមួយអង្គងទទឹង)។ សម្រាប់ប្រឡាយទទឹងបាត B ដែលមានការហូរសរុប Q ប៉ាន់ q<sub>t</sub> ≈ Q / B ឬគណនាពីលក្ខខណ្ឌជម្រៅ​វិកលណ្ឌ​នៅច្រករបៀងបញ្ចូល។

rc_notes_2_term.current_translation: ចំណុះប្រតិបត្តិការក្នុងមួយអង្គង
rc_notes_2_term.intent: Amount of flow per unit width

rc_notes_3_def.english: A fraction of the total flow moves through the pores of the rock riprap (mantle flow q<sub>m</sub>); the remainder flows over the rock surface (q<sub>s</sub> = q<sub>t</sub> − q<sub>m</sub>). The flow depth d is computed from Manning’s equation applied to the surface flow q<sub>s</sub> using the chute roughness n. Default porosity n<sub>p</sub> = 0.45 is typical for angular crushed rock.
rc_notes_3_def.current_translation: ផ្នែកនៃការហូរសរុបហូរតាមរន្ធ riprap (ការហូរស្រទាប់ q<sub>m</sub>); សំណល់ហូរលើផ្ទៃថ្ម (q<sub>s</sub> = q<sub>t</sub> − q<sub>m</sub>)។ ជម្រៅទឹក d គណនាពីសមីការ Manning’s ដែលប្រើចំពោះការហូរផ្ទៃ q<sub>s</sub> ដោយប្រើភាពរដុបរបស់ ch ute n។ ប្រហោងលំនាំដើម n<sub>p</sub> = 0.45 ជារឿងធម្មតាសម្រាប់ថ្មកិន​ជ្រួញ។

rc_notes_3_term.current_translation: ការហូរតាមស្រទាប់ថ្ម
rc_notes_3_term.intent: Amount of Flow Through the Rock Mantle

rc_notes_4_def.english: Robinson, K.M., Rice, C.E., and Kadavy, K.C. (1998). “Design of rock chutes.” Transactions of the ASAE, 41(3), 621–626. USDA ARS also publishes an Excel spreadsheet based on the same method.
rc_notes_4_def.current_translation: Robinson, K.M., Rice, C.E., and Kadavy, K.C. (1998). "រចនា rock chutes." Transactions of the ASAE, 41(3), 621–626. USDA ARS ក៏បោះពុម្ពផ្សាយ សន្លឹក Excel ដោយផ្អែកលើវិធីដូចគ្នា។

rc_notes_5_def.english: The equations were developed using a D<sub>50</sub> range of 15 mm to 278 mm. Results outside this range are extrapolated and should be used with additional engineering judgement.
rc_notes_5_def.current_translation: សមីការត្រូវបានបង្កើតដោយប្រើជួរ D<sub>50</sub> ពី 15 mm ដល់ 278 mm។ លទ្ធផលក្រៅជួរនេះត្រូវបានដកស្រង់ពីក្រៅ ហើយត្រូវប្រើដោយមានការវិនិច្ឆ័យបន្ថែមពីអ្នកវិស្វករ។

rc_notes_5_term.current_translation: ជួរទំហំថ្មត្រឹមត្រូវ

rc_notes_6_def.english: The elevation of the top of riprap in the outlet reach should be at or below the downstream channel bed elevation. If it is higher, the outlet rock will be unstable.
rc_notes_6_def.current_translation: កម្រិតកំពូលនៃ riprap នៅក្នុងជួរចេញគួរស្ថិតនៅលើ ឬក្រោមកម្រិតបាតប្រឡាយទឹកខ្ពស់ទាបខ្ពស់ទាប។ ប្រសិនបើខ្ពស់ជាងនេះ ថ្ម​ចេញនឹងមិនស្ថិរ។
rc_notes_6_def.intent: Apron is the flat protective pad of rock at the chute outlet (hydraulic-structures term, the platea/radier family), never clothing. Downstream means toward the outlet, below the structure.

rc_notes_6_term.current_translation: កម្រិតក្រណាត់ចេញ

rc_notes_7_def.english: When the normal depth in the inlet channel is less than the weir head (H<sub>p</sub>) required to pass q<sub>t</sub>, restricted flow or ponding occurs upstream of the chute inlet. This is generally acceptable — ponding reduces velocity and prevents erosion upstream. To check: use a weir flow calculator to find H<sub>p</sub> for the given q<sub>t</sub> and crest width, and compare it to the inlet channel normal depth. If H<sub>p</sub> exceeds normal depth, ponding will occur.
rc_notes_7_def.current_translation: នៅពេលជម្រៅធម្មតានៅក្នុងប្រឡាយបញ្ចូលតិចជាងជម្រៅទឹក weir (H<sub>p</sub>) ដែលចាំបាច់ដើម្បីឆ្លងកាត់ q<sub>t</sub> ការហូររួមចង្អៀត ឬទឹកដាំងកើតឡើងខ្ពស់ទឹក​​នៃ​ apron បញ្ចូល។ នេះជាទូទៅអាចទទួលយកបាន — ទឹកដាំងកាត់បន្ថយល្បឿន និងការពារការហូរច្រោះខ្ពស់ទឹក។ ដើម្បីត្រួតពិនិត្យ: ប្រើម៉ាស៊ីនគណនា weir flow ដើម្បីស្វែងរក H<sub>p</sub> សម្រាប់ q<sub>t</sub> និងទទឹង crest ដែលបានផ្ដល់ ហើយប្រៀបធៀបជាមួយជម្រៅធម្មតានៅក្នុងប្រឡាយបញ្ចូល។ ប្រសិនបើ H<sub>p</sub> លើសជម្រៅធម្មតា ទឹកដាំងនឹងកើតឡើង។
rc_notes_7_def.intent: Weir head is the water-surface height above the crest, a length, not a pressure. Upstream means above/before the inlet, toward the source. Ponding upstream is beneficial here.

rc_np.current_translation: ប្រហោង Riprap, n<sub>p</sub>
rc_np.intent: Volume of voids divided by the total riprap aggregate volume including rock and voids

rc_pond_ok.current_translation: Hp > yn — ទឹកដាំងខ្ពស់ ✓
rc_pond_ok.intent: The condition is good. There is ponding upstream of the chute

rc_pond_ok_tip.english: Ponding upstream of the chute inlet is good; it reduces erosion upstream. (USDA)
rc_pond_ok_tip.current_translation: Ponding upstream of the chute inlet is good; it reduces erosion upstream. (USDA)

rc_pond_warn.english: H<sub>p</sub> ≤ y<sub>n</sub> — no ponding — inlet erosion potential
rc_pond_warn.current_translation: ⚠ Hp ≤ yn — គ្មានទឹកដាំង — ត្រួតពិនិត្យច្រករបៀងសម្រាប់ការហូរច្រោះ
rc_pond_warn.intent: The condition is bad. There is no ponding upstream of the chute. This could create erosion upstream of the chute

rc_pond_warn_tip.english: No ponding upstream of the chute inlet; erosion could occur upstream. (USDA)
rc_pond_warn_tip.current_translation: No ponding upstream of the chute inlet; erosion could occur upstream. (USDA)

rc_ponding_check.current_translation: ការត្រួតពិនិត្យទឹកដាំងនៅច្រករបៀង
rc_ponding_check.intent: This reports the result of verifying the validity of the depth of the ponding at the inlet of the chute.

rc_qm.current_translation: ចំណុះប្រតិបត្តិការក្នុងមួយអង្គងតាមស្រទាប់, q<sub>m</sub>
rc_qm.intent: This is the unit flow through the voids of the rock aggregate (riprap)

rc_qs.current_translation: ចំណុះប្រតិបត្តិការក្នុងមួយអង្គងលើផ្ទៃ, q<sub>s</sub> (q<sub>t</sub> − q<sub>m</sub>)
rc_qs.intent: This is the unit flow above the rock aggregate (riprap)

rc_qt.english: Total unit discharge, qt ?
rc_qt.current_translation: ចំណុះប្រតិបត្តិការក្នុងមួយអង្គង, qt ?
rc_qt.intent: Flow per unit width at the steep channel or spillway or rock ramp inlet.

rc_sg.english: Rock specific gravity, sg ?
rc_sg.current_translation: ទំងន់ប្រភេទថ្ម, sg ?
rc_sg.intent: Specific gravity: dimensionless ratio of rock density to water density (relative density). | Not specific weight, which has units.

rc_sg_check.current_translation: ការត្រួតពិនិត្យទំងន់ប្រភេទ
rc_sg_check.intent: This is a check of the validity of the provided specific gravity of the rock

rc_sg_high.current_translation: ការព្រមាន: sg > 2.82 — លើសជួរ Robinson
rc_sg_high.intent: This is a warning. The specific gravity is above the range that is allowed by Robinson.

rc_sg_low.current_translation: ការព្រមាន: sg < 2.54 — ក្រោមជួរ Robinson
rc_sg_low.intent: This is a warning. The specific gravity is below the range that is allowed by Robinson.

rc_sg_ok.current_translation: sg ស្ថិតក្នុងជួរត្រឹមត្រូវ (2.54–2.82) ✓
rc_sg_ok.intent: The specific gravity is within the range of validity

rc_yn.english: Normal depth in inlet channel, yn ?
rc_yn.current_translation: ជម្រៅធម្មតានៅក្នុងប្រឡាយបញ្ចូល, yn ?
rc_yn.intent: Enter the normal depth in the channel that delivers flow to this chute. | Upstream, not downstream: ponding reduces erosion UPSTREAM of the chute inlet (above/before it, toward the source). Do not flip the direction.
